name: Product card
description: A shoppable card with image, badge, title, rating, price (with strike-through), and add-to-cart.

name: Star rating & review
description: An aggregate rating summary with a distribution breakdown beside an individual review card.

name: Cart / order summary
description: A checkout-side summary: line items, a promo field, the totals breakdown, and the pay button.

name: Filter sidebar
description: A faceted filter rail — category checkboxes, a price range, and active filter chips you can clear.

name: Countdown timer
description: An urgency timer for sales and launches, ticking down in days / hours / minutes / seconds.

name: Avatar group & social proof
description: Stacked, overlapping avatars with an overflow count — the "join 2,000+ others" cue.
